brief:
The Bureau of the Committee on the Exercise of the Inalienable Rights of the Palestinian People held a meeting on Tuesday with United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres, according to Middle East Eye. Details of the discussion were not immediately available.

The committee, a UN body established to advance Palestinian self-determination, regularly engages with senior UN officials on matters affecting Palestinians and the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.
